messages:
Eva (docs): Quick thread for the relnotes / changelog entry we're shipping Friday. Two ask: (1) a short customer-facing blurb about function-calling + structured outputs, and (2) a tiny migration snippet for the SSE streaming change (old webhook-style -> Server-Sent Events). Any known issues we should call out? :sparkles:

Marco (eng): On the runtime side, function-calling now returns a strict JSON field `structured_output` for easier parsing. This reduces parsing errors but means some very loose existing clients that parsed freeform text may break. We should recommend using the SDK parser helper until clients update. I'll paste a short tech note and a runtime link.

Owen (sdk): SDK change: added `parse_structured_output()` helper in v0.23.0 and we updated streaming to prefer SSE. We'll accept old webhook streaming for one release but it's deprecated and will warn. I'll add code snippets for both JS/Python - both a quick parse example and an SSE client example.

Dina (product): Customer blurb should be upbeat and minimal. Suggest: "Structured function outputs and improved streaming deliver more reliable integrations; see migration notes for SSE and parser helpers." Keep it one sentence.

Eva (docs): Using that exact sentence. For the docs page we need a "Migration checklist" with three tiny items: update SDK, swap webhook->SSE, run the parse helper. Can we make each a one-line code snippet?

Owen (sdk): Yup. Tiny snippets below. JS parse example and SSE consumer (browser/node):

```js
// parse helper
const resp = await client.generate({ prompt })
const data = client.parse_structured_output(resp)
```

```js
// SSE streaming (recommended)
const evtSource = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-4-mini')
evtSource.onmessage = (e) => { console.log('chunk', JSON.parse(e.data)) }
```

```js
// Deprecated webhook pattern (will warn)
// POST /callbacks
// body: { request_id, chunk }
```

```py
# parse helper
resp = client.generate(prompt)
data = client.parse_structured_output(resp)
```

```py
# SSE (recommended)
import sseclient
resp = requests.get('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-4-mini', stream=True)
client = sseclient.SSEClient(resp)
for event in client.events():
    print(json.loads(event.data))
```

Marco (eng): Known issue to call out: when using SSE behind some corporate proxies, clients may see connection resets. Workaround: enable chunked transfer (`Transfer-Encoding: chunked`) on proxy or fall back to short-polling mode (we'll link to proxy troubleshooting). I'll add a short repro and link.

Kai (devex): I'll add a CI smoke test in examples that verifies parse_structured_output returns valid JSON for the canonical function-calling prompt. Also lint examples to detect deprecated webhook callback usage. I'll PR today.

Eva (docs): Good. Also we have a handful of broken anchors in the function-calling guide after the restructure. Marco, can you paste one mapping so I include it in the relnote so users who have bookmarks aren't confused?

Marco (eng): Example redirect: `/docs/guides/function-calling#output-parsing` -> `/docs/guides/function-calling#structured-output`. I'll put the full map in the PR.

Dina (product): Also add a short "If you see errors" troubleshooting bullet: run the parse helper and check SDK version >= 0.23.0. If SSE disconnects, switch to polling. Keep it 1-2 lines.

Eva (docs): Will do. Draft relnote plan: 1) public blurb (Dina line), 2) tech note (structured_output + SDK helper), 3) migration snippets (SSE + parse helper + deprecation note), 4) known issues (proxy resets, SSE edgecases, broken anchors redirect). I'll post the draft in this thread for a quick review by EOD today.

Owen (sdk): PRs: sdk#812 (parse helper docs + examples), sdk#813 (deprecation warning for webhook). I'll post links when ready.

Kai (devex): PR opened: examples#256 (CI smoke + webhook lint).

DeployBot: staging docs build started for branch `release/docs-218555`  logs: https://ci.internal/builds/218555 :rocket:

Marco (eng): Runtime link for SSE/proxy note: https://ci.internal/runtime/changes/2026-03-20 - includes repro and recommended proxy settings.

Eva (docs): Action items: Owen -> post snippet PR links + ensure warning text is copy-editable, Marco -> full redirect map + runtime link pasted into PR, Kai -> examples CI PR link, Dina -> final approve customer blurb. I'll assemble relnote and ping in 2 hours.

Dina (product): Approved. One-sentence blurb only.

Eva (docs): Posting draft shortly. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
